$description: Structured data rules read from Google's live documentation on 2026-11-01. make site checks every page's JSON-LD against them (tools/dsapkit/src/dsapkit/site/jsonld.py); make docs-drift compares the pages below with jsonld-rules.lock.json. Before changing a rule, read the page it cites and update 'updated' and 'checked'. Never decide a format from memory.

formats.datetime: ISO 8601 date and time with a timezone offset or Z, for example 2026-11-01T09:00:00+05:30. Google recommends the offset; without it Google assumes Googlebot's timezone.
formats.datetime-or-date: ISO 8601. A date alone (2026-11-01) when the hour is not known; otherwise a local date and time (2026-11-01T19:00) whose zone is the event's. A midnight timestamp is wrong unless the event starts at midnight.
formats.date-partial: ISO 8601 date as a year (1994), a month (1994-06) or a day (1994-06-15); Google asks for 'ISO 8601 date format' for foundingDate.
formats.phone: With the country code and the area code, for example +91 22 6971 9828.
formats.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example IN.
formats.day-of-week: A schema.org day URL (https://schema.org/Monday) or the short name (Monday).
formats.text: Plain text: not empty, no HTML tags.

multiType: A node with several types must meet the required properties of every type; recommended properties come from its first type, so list the most specific type first.

Organization.note: Home page. Use the same name and alternateName as the site name. Logo at least 112x112 px, crawlable. address.addressCountry is the two-letter code.

WebSite.note: Home page only, domain root url. The root redirects to /en/ and Google reads the redirect target, so the markup lives on /en/. One WebSite node per home page; use the same data on every duplicate home page.

LocalBusiness.note: One per centre, on its centre page, with the most specific subtype. Several types go in an array (additionalType is not supported). Ratings only for sites that review other businesses.

BreadcrumbList.note: At least two ListItems. The last item may leave out item; Google then uses the page itself. Must match the visible trail; built from routes.json.

ItemList.note: Course list on a summary page: at least three courses, each ListItem with position and a unique canonical url.

ListItem.note: Checked against the rules of the list that holds it.

Course.note: Only for real curricula. Google shows only the first 60 characters of description, so the first sentence must stand alone.

BlogPosting.note: No required properties. Each author is its own object; do not merge several authors into one name. Images: crawlable, at least 50,000 pixels (width times height), ideally 16x9, 4x3 and 1x1.

Event.note: Physical events only (an admission test day, an open day). Never remove startDate when an event is cancelled or postponed. Not for business hours or coupons.

retired.FAQPage: FAQ rich results are no longer shown and the documentation was removed 2026-06-15. FAQs stay as visible HTML.
retired.EducationalOccupationalProgram: Not a Google rich result; there is no Course-info result either (retired 2025).

watch.why: Markup must be visible on the page, up to date, relevant and complete.
Which types have a rich result at all.
Sitelinks are automatic; titles and structure are what we control.
lastmod is used only if consistently and verifiably accurate; priority and changefreq are ignored.
hreflang and x-default, in tags or in the sitemap.
max-image-preview:large lets Search show a large image preview; noindex keeps a page out.
No extra requirements for AI Overviews and AI Mode; structured data must match visible text.
llms.txt, chunking and special markup are not used by Google Search.
